title: Create: Estrogen (ITALIAN) Alessandra15204
description: Italian translation of Myaqq create Estrogen mod
body:
Resourcepack to translate the mod Create: Estrogen to Italian🇮🇹🇪🇺.
This translation is **unofficial**, but mod developers are welcome to use them in their mods officially. This is licensed on MIT License :3

**Installation:**
1. Download the zip file
2. Go to your .minecraft and find the resourcepack folder
3. Move the zip to the resourcepacks folder
4. Apply the resourcepack in game
5. Set your in game language to Italian



This project was made using tools by Hispanic Translation Team (Public Domain)

-Alesandra15204
